content: Best practices for extracting Compose screens: Separate into Route/Screen (container) and Content. The Route composable connects the ViewModel, collects UI state, and handles navigation events. It should take the ViewModel directly, e.g., 'viewModel: MyViewModel = hiltViewModel()', but avoid doing so as a default parameter in the Content function. The Content composable takes only immutable UI state and callbacks, containing pure UI layout without any DI or ViewModel knowledge, which makes it easily previewable and testable. Further deconstruct the Content into smaller named composables when nesting is deep or a UI section has a distinct responsibility. Reusable components (e.g., generic buttons) should go to a shared ui/components package, while screen-specific ones stay in the feature package.
